summary: Vernon Parish lookout tower near the community of Evans; Wikipedia lists it torn down, with aerial imagery pointing to demolition between 2016 and 2018. No build or staffing source found.

facts.status_note: Wikipedia list says torn down; its note says aerial imagery suggests demolition between 2016 and 2018

events.note: Earliest year of the 2016-2018 window in which aerial imagery suggests demolition; not a confirmed date

evidence.supports: the Evans tower is listed as torn down
aerial imagery shows the tower; demolition appears between 2016 and 2018
evidence.quote: Tower is visible in historical aerial imagery. Appears to have seen demolition between 2016 and 2018.

evidence.supports: the tower is listed as Evans Lookout Tower in Vernon Parish, with Evans as the nearest town

evidence.quote: There is what is now called a cultural lookout tower known locally as the Evans lookout tower

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, both Wikipedia, and neither dates construction, height, agency or staffing, so the story leaves those out. The Clear Creek article's citation for the tower is titled 'Evans fire tower' but its link is not in the cache, so it is not cited. The anyplaceamerica listing returned 403. Coordinates in the record (30.9825, -93.43944) match the Wikipedia list. Suggest a dated aerial or Louisiana Forestry Commission record before publishing the demolition window as more than a Wikipedia estimate. Used two web searches and three reads.
